files.content: ## Saasternity 💻 An open source SaaS boilerplate (starter kit) for building your next SaaS application. ## Checklist - [ ] Landing Page - [ ] Authentication (NextAuth, Clerk) - [ ] Protected Routes and Pages - [ ] Dashboard - [ ] Billing (Stripe and Lemon Squeezy) - [ ] Database (PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB) - [ ] ORM (Drizzle and Prisma) - [ ] Profile - [ ] Integrations - [ ] API Routes - [ ] Deployment - [ ] SEO - [ ] Analytics (PostHog) - [ ] Organizations - [ ] Transactional emails (Resend, Mailgun) - [ ] CMS for managing content (Strapi, MDX)
